source_note: Working updated isolate. complete_baseline.json was not edited. cone_holonomy.json was not edited. Old engine files were not edited. A formula is a lock only when type, uniqueness from the locked atoms, and extras = 0 all hold.

filter.reading: One three-way lock. The three parts are equal at once.
filter.star_meaning: Ψ★ is the same involution as the left star. It is not a second operator and not a new real.
filter.wall_reading: j2 = 0, where the defect ||★Ψ − Ψ||^2 vanishes

barrier.meaning: Minus eigenspace of the same involution. Separate from ★Ψ = Ψ = Ψ★. Not the formula max(0, round(4*j1-6)). Not a twistor choice.

locks.name: ambient_theory
locks.why: Constitution statement 1 already fixes the ambient dimension at 14 and names both 5-folds as compact factors. fibration_class stays not unique.

locks.name: filter_three_way
locks.reading: One equality. Three parts equal at once.
locks.why: The three parts ★Ψ, Ψ, and Ψ★ are one lock. Ψ★ is that same involution, not a second coupling.

locks.name: wall_zero_count
locks.reading: N_gen = 3 stays frozen. The integer is the wall-zero count of the three harmonics 2⊕3⊕4. It is not a copied 4D Weyl triplet, not ker D_5, and not the APS index theorem.
locks.why: The integer 3 stays. It counts the three distinct harmonics 2⊕3⊕4.

locks.name: barrier_minus
locks.why: Middle degree on the 14-dimensional theory is 7. The same involution has a minus eigenspace. That eigenspace is the barrier, not the filter.

locks.name: clock_Z24
locks.why: Monodromy order 24 equals lcm(8,3,8). The unique subgroup of order 8 has index 3. The least positive element of order 3 is +8. No new integer.

locks.name: lambda_tilde
locks.reading: Three outputs of the wall zeros. Not one 4D mass.

locks.name: T_wall_identity

locks.name: eight_pi_G_eff_number
locks.reading: Pure number κ = 8π G_eff = 9/16. Not G_N. Live identity: 4κ = 9/4, therefore 4κ+1 = 13/4. C_2(3)=4/3 is the name on the ratio, not a color group. The lock-name pair 9/4 is not this identity.

locks.name: CONE

maps.why: The live values are 4κ = 9/4 and 4κ+1 = 13/4. A lock-name that calls the pair 9/4 uses the value of 4κ for the other slot. That name is an extra. κ itself is the locked number 9/16.

maps.name: hop_mass
maps.why: κ = 9/16 and n_η = (3, 8, 15) are locked. The algebraic type is a pure number, and no GeV conversion is applied. HOP_MASS_UNIQUENESS.md scores the listed locks one atom at a time. No atom forces one τ from {2-sqrt(2), 3, 2+sqrt(2)}. No atom forces the product branch against the zero branch. Leftover extras are tau and hop_case. The dimensionless type matches, uniqueness fails, and extras are not empty, so the status stays MAP.
